title: Let complaint leave the mouth
summary: Let gentleness stay truthful without surrendering its backbone. Do not let the day outrun this: keep this in front of you: serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.
lifeApplication: When the heart hardens, lower the tone and tell the truth in a way the room can still receive.

source.shortMeaning: Service softens the mind until complaint no longer leads.
source.lifeApplication: When protest rises, serve first and let the mouth grow quieter.
